title: Concept: Archive extraction via ExtractToDirectory (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, ExtractToDirectory writes archive members to the filesystem. Entry names are attacker-controlled metadata in hostile archives, so extraction without name checks is a write primitive. The remedy is per-entry validation via entry enumeration with name checks.
applicability: csharp codebases extracting archives through ExtractToDirectory; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file overwrite (Zip Slip) from hostile archives; HIGH severity because archives routinely cross trust boundaries.
